title: Defy Destiny - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: Defy Destiny trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: Defy Destiny phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The platinum is automatic once the other 35 are done - nothing extra is required, and no difficulty setting gates it. That single fact is why the whole set can be finished in one run.

sections.title: How to Earn
sections.content: Earn every other trophy in the list.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: Trophy 1 of 36 on the list - after it The Heart's Journey. It is not missable, so a missed run can be finished later without a restart. The full list with rarity is on the trophy list; the Platinum route and the order to do things in are on the trophy guide.
